title: How is Diddy connected to George Washington?
description:
A real photo links Diddy to Donald Trump, and the line of presidents runs from Trump back to George Washington.

Sean Combs → Donald Trump → George Washington

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Diddy → Donald Trump: In 1998, Diddy and Donald Trump posed together at a celebrity polo match in the Hamptons.
   Photo by Sonia Moskowitz / Getty Images, via Hot 97, Fair use (commentary): https://www.hot97.com/news/president-donald-trump-responds-to-diddy-pardon-allegations/
2. Donald Trump → George Washington (45 portraits, every holder): And in 2025, Trump became the 47th president, in a line going back to George Washington.
